title: Nyakio Grieco Accelerates Thirteen Lune’s Global Expansion With South Africa Launch and Starting $15M Fundraise
summary: Thirteen Lune CEO Nyakio Grieco is gearing up for the platform's international debut in South Africa with Takealot, while launching a $15 million fundraising initiative to fuel global and domestic growth.
